name: Contour Key Portrait
description: One hard side key cuts a graphic line across the face and body of the same identity-locked model in every frame — a coherent campaign, not six different people. Fashion-plate poise throughout.
lighting: Hard side key, graphic shadow edge
subject: person
prompt: standing in a three-quarter turn against a seamless mid-grey studio ground, chest-up to waist-up crop centered in frame, one hard side key light cutting a graphic line down the face and body, a crisp controlled shadow falling across the far side, poised fashion-plate posture, chin lifted, tack-sharp editorial retouch, magazine-plate finish
